subject: prd/planner-driven-model-routing
statement: Where the strongest-profile kill switch is engaged, each harness role shall prefer its strongest approved native profile only when that profile satisfies every requested semantic minimum; otherwise the system shall apply FR-10 before claim or invocation, while preserving FR-25's assurance-pass floor and FR-26's aggregation behavior.
rationale: fallback may overprovide but can never weaken the frozen contract or bypass required review process
fit_criterion: kill-switch drills prove capability, deliberation, context, and assurance dominance for every resolved cell; unsatisfiable fixtures fail under FR-10; harness selection, assurance-pass depth/count, mutual blindness, and aggregate behavior remain unchanged
